name: Same-host surface route shootout
compare: LG/KVMFR vs Parsec vs Sunshine/Moonlight vs RDP/SPICE on the same VM
metrics: capture→enqueue, input→photon, CPU/GPU/copy engines, frame pacing, quality
matrix: Idle and mixed game/compiler load; 60/120/144 Hz; SDR/HDR
gate: Select minimum valid path; document stage count.

name: Input switch torture
compare: Central broker vs QEMU grabs; randomized held keys/buttons/raw mouse
metrics: stuck state, switch p50/p95/p99/max, lost/duplicated events
matrix: 1M transitions, target crash, coordinator crash, hotplug
gate: Zero stuck/lost ownership failures.

name: MacBook sink matrix
compare: HEVC/H.264/available codecs, 8/10-bit, 60/120 Hz, scale modes
metrics: decode time, compositor delay, thermals, dropped frames, power
matrix: M1 Pro local workload plus remote desktop/game
gate: Choose supported profiles; no assumed AV1 hardware.

name: HDR/color chain
compare: Windows/Linux source to C27HG70 and M1 Pro
metrics: DeltaE/gamut coverage where instrumented, clipping, metadata, banding
matrix: SDR, PQ HDR, desktop text, game, video
gate: Controlled policy no worse than native baseline within tolerance.

name: Ableton isolation
compare: Ableton project at several buffer sizes with cargo build, game E2E, inference and disk I/O
metrics: xruns, callback deadline, round-trip latency, DPC/scheduler spikes
matrix: Local and routed audio; CPU/GPU/network saturation
gate: No xruns within admitted envelope; honest rejection otherwise.

name: Network audio clock soak
compare: Independent PC/Mac clocks over wired LAN
metrics: drift estimate error, buffer occupancy, ASRC ratio, glitch count
gate: Stable occupancy and zero audible discontinuity.

name: Independent queue isolation
compare: Bulk clipboard/file transfer during input/audio/video
metrics: input p99, audio xrun, video frame age, transfer throughput
matrix: Shared vs isolated queues; congestion and packet loss
gate: RT classes unaffected within gate.

name: Explicit placement corpus
compare: Rust builds, tests, game E2E, encoding, inference, compression
metrics: completion, queue, transfer, energy, foreground externality
matrix: Main PC/Mac/bench/remote nodes with cold/warm data
gate: Cost model picks measured winner above threshold.

name: Object residency
compare: Immutable object cache, spill and replicas
metrics: copy count, lookup, transfer, corruption recovery, space
matrix: SHM, SSD, LAN, WAN, node loss
gate: Correct authority/version and positive cache benefit.

name: Fusion/fission
compare: Synthetic micro-ops and real build/inference traces
metrics: decision overhead, completion, migrations, oscillation
gate: Adaptive policy beats atomic-every-time and static-region baselines.

name: Prefetch prediction
compare: Known workflow transitions and adversarial changes
metrics: cold-start p95, hit rate, bytes wasted, eviction externality
matrix: Build, agent tool, game E2E, Ableton project
gate: Net p95 gain inside waste budget.

name: Seamless app compatibility
compare: Representative Windows/Linux apps including browser, IDE, video, Blender, dialogs
metrics: window graph correctness, IME, DPI, cursor, latency, encoder sessions
gate: Per-app route and fallback recorded.

name: Surface atlas
compare: 1–32 proxy windows with static/motion mixes
metrics: encoder sessions, bandwidth, interaction latency, artifacts
gate: Atlas beneficial for static mix; dedicated for high-motion as selected.

name: WAN impairment
compare: Desktop/app/audio/input over latency/loss/jitter/bandwidth transitions
metrics: p50/p95/p99, recovery, quality changes, disconnect time
matrix: Network emulator and real remote node
gate: No unsafe focus; stable adaptation and resumability.

name: Partition/fencing
compare: Coordinator and link partitions during route/focus transaction
metrics: dual ownership, stale acceptance, rollback time
gate: No stale-token action accepted.

name: Agent realm lifecycle
compare: Provision N VMs/sandboxes, publish surfaces, expire/restore
metrics: time-to-ready, cleanup leaks, focus theft, evidence completeness
gate: No focus theft; bounded cleanup and fallback.

name: OOB recovery
compare: OS hang, driver crash, no boot, wrong display, network path failure
metrics: time to control/recover, action count
gate: Defined recovery coverage for each important host.

name: Security adversarial suite
compare: Pairing MITM, stale tokens, malicious adapter, clipboard exfiltration, input logger, OOB exposure
metrics: exploit success, detection, containment, audit
gate: No critical open finding at promotion.

name: FUSE coalescing/offload
compare: ShareCLI-like repeated build/read patterns
metrics: overhead, duplicate bytes/work, completion, correctness
gate: Graduate only positive bounded workload.

name: Atomic mediation envelope
compare: Function/syscall/kernel candidates across locality tiers
metrics: break-even granularity, marshal/sync cost, failures
gate: Publish empirical granularity map, not universal claim.

name: User workflow comparison
compare: Separate apps vs unified shell for desk/couch/bench/agent tasks
metrics: actions, errors, completion, cognitive load, recovery
gate: Unified shell materially improves workflow without hiding failures.
